description: This file defines an abstract class 'AbstractPolicyMongoEventAdapter' that implements the 'EventAdapter' interface for handling serialization and deserialization of 'PolicyEvent' objects to and from a MongoDB-compatible BSON format. It includes methods for converting events to journal format, reconstructing events from stored data, and migrating payload structures for compatibility.

classes.name: AbstractPolicyMongoEventAdapter
classes.description: An abstract class providing BSON serialization/deserialization for 'PolicyEvent' objects, handling JSON migration and error logging.

methods.name: manifest
methods.description: Returns the type string of a 'PolicyEvent' object, or throws an error if the event is not of this type.

methods.name: toJournal
methods.description: Converts a 'PolicyEvent' to its BSON representation suitable for storage in the journal.

methods.name: fromJournal
methods.description: Reconstructs an 'Event' from its BSON stored form.

methods.name: tryToCreateEventFrom
methods.description: Attempts to create an 'Event' from a JSON value, with error handling and logging.

methods.name: createEventFrom
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses for creating events from JSON.

methods.name: migratePayload
methods.description: Migrates older event JSON payloads to the current format by unwrapping the 'payload' field.
